scientific_question: Was the failed 06a gate caused by insufficient optimization or by loss of the intra-millisecond voltage path?

voltage_contexts: linear interpolation between teacher boundary voltages
authentic teacher voltage microtrace at 0.125 ms intervals

roles.checkpoint_selection: best train-derived calibration checkpoint within each fixed budget

evaluation.primary_metric: development coordinate-weighted one-step normalized-delta RMSE improvement over persistence
evaluation.rollout_window_policy: all horizons are prefixes of the same deterministically selected 8 ms development windows

decision_rules.path_information_identified: teacher-path long-budget gain is at least 2% and exceeds endpoint long-budget gain by at least 1 percentage point
decision_rules.optimization_budget_identified: a long-budget arm reaches 2% and gains at least 1 percentage point over its paired short checkpoint
decision_rules.neither: no long-budget arm reaches the 2% gate
decision_rules.factor_unresolved: a long-budget arm reaches 2% without either preregistered factor effect
